description: This file defines an immutable Java class `ImmutableJsonLong` representing a JSON number that fits into a Java `long`. It provides methods to create instances, check type safely, equality comparison, hash code, and serialization logic.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonLong
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON number that fits into Java's long type, extending `AbstractJsonNumber<Long>` and providing specific behaviors for long integers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an ImmutableJsonLong instance with a specified long value.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the stored value fits into an integer range.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Confirms the value is a long, always true for this class.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare long values or objects extending `AbstractJsonNumber`.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the long value, with special handling if value fits in int.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the long value using the provided serialization context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Provides an upper bound estimate for string representation size of the long value.
